# Cloudflare Unified Cron Platform

> A private, single-account control plane that turns one Cloudflare Cron Trigger into durable, auditable schedules executed through allowlisted Service Binding RPC targets.

The browser console and JSON API share one origin. The API base path is `/api/v1`. This is an operations system, not a general job queue: schedules come from Worker Registration, D1 is the control-state source of truth, and RPC side effects remain at-least-once unless the target implements business idempotency.

JSON success responses use `{ "data": ... }` and may include `meta`. Errors use `{ "error": { "code", "message", "requestId", "details"? } }`. Unknown `/api` paths return JSON `404`, not the SPA.

There are two separate authentication boundaries:

- Administrator endpoints use the HttpOnly control-console session cookie. Login and logout require same-origin JSON requests.
- Worker Registration uses `Authorization: Bearer ucrt_<token>` and never grants administrator access. A token is bound server-side to one preauthorized Target.

Authenticated mutation requests require `Content-Type: application/json`, an exact allowed `Origin`, and an `Idempotency-Key` containing 8..128 characters from `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -`. Schedule pause/resume also require `If-Match: "<revision>"`. Request bodies are limited to 64 KiB.

Execution identity is stable across Retry. Retry creates a new Attempt but preserves the Execution and business idempotency key. Run again creates a new Execution and a new idempotency key. A timeout or broken RPC connection is `unknown`; it does not prove that the business side effect did not happen.

The internal Target RPC surface is not an HTTP API. An allowlisted `CronEntrypoint` exposes `describe(): Promise<unknown>` and `cron(input: unknown): Promise<unknown>` through a Cloudflare Service Binding. Protocol version is currently `1`.

Never place administrator passwords, session cookies, Registration Tokens, Cloudflare API tokens, Account IDs, D1 IDs, or complete request headers in prompts, logs, URLs, payload examples, or test reports.

## Public session and Worker Registration

- [Read administrator session](/api/v1/auth/session): `GET`; returns authenticated state and username when a valid session exists.
- [Administrator login](/api/v1/auth/login): `POST`; JSON `{ "username": string, "password": string }`; sets the HttpOnly session cookie on success.
- [Administrator logout](/api/v1/auth/logout): `POST`; JSON `{}`; revokes the current session and clears its cookie.
- [Publish Worker Registration](/api/v1/registration): `PUT`; requires Registration Bearer token and `Idempotency-Key`; accepts the complete versioned Worker declaration.

## Authenticated read APIs

- [Trigger deliveries](/api/v1/deliveries): `GET`; optional `scheduleId` and `limit=1..1000`; returns recent delivery rows and global status counts. `queued` means durable Queue acceptance, never business success. `businessResult=null` means not reported. Legacy Execution success rates exclude these deliveries.

- [Operational overview](/api/v1/overview): `GET`; schedule counts, recent executions, 24-hour status distribution, success-rate windows, and scheduler state.
- [List schedules](/api/v1/schedules): `GET`; optional `search`, `target`, and `enabled=true|false` query parameters.
- [Schedule detail](/api/v1/schedules/{scheduleId}): `GET`; configuration snapshot and recent executions.
- [Preview Cron occurrences](/api/v1/cron/preview): `POST`; JSON `{ "cronExpression", "timezone", "count"?, "after"? }`; read-only calculation but still follows authenticated mutation headers.
- [List targets](/api/v1/targets): `GET`; deployed Target metadata joined with D1 state, Registration, and declared Actions.
- [Target detail](/api/v1/targets/{targetId}): `GET`; Target state, schedules, Registration, and Action capabilities.
- [List executions](/api/v1/executions): `GET`; optional `status`, `source`, `scheduleId`, `from`, `to`, `cursor`, and `limit` query parameters; maximum page size is 50.
- [Execution detail](/api/v1/executions/{executionId}): `GET`; immutable dispatch snapshot, Attempts, result, error, lease, retry, and operator-resolution evidence.
- [Audit events](/api/v1/audit-events): `GET`; optional `cursor` and `limit`; maximum page size is 50.
- [System state](/api/v1/system): `GET`; dispatch pause, scheduler heartbeat, build, protocol, and budget evidence.
- [Success rates](/api/v1/success-rates): `GET`; `window=24h|7d|30d` plus optional `targetId` and `scheduleId`.
- [Registration Tokens](/api/v1/registration-tokens): `GET`; metadata only. Raw token values are never returned after the issuing response.

## Authenticated mutation APIs

- [Scheduler capacity](/api/v1/system/scheduler-settings): `POST`; requires `If-Match` from System `settingsRevision` plus normal mutation headers. Strict JSON: `max_schedules`, `materialize_budget`, `delivery_budget` (1..1000); `rpc_budget` (1..20); `concurrency` (1..10); `per_target_batch` (1..100). System returns the current `schedulerSettings` and `settingsRevision`.

- [Pause schedule](/api/v1/schedules/{scheduleId}/pause): `POST`; JSON `{}` plus `If-Match`; persists an Operator Override.
- [Resume schedule](/api/v1/schedules/{scheduleId}/resume): `POST`; JSON `{}` plus `If-Match`; clears only the Operator Override.
- [Check target](/api/v1/targets/{targetId}/check): `POST`; JSON `{}`; compares side-effect-free `describe()` output with the latest Registration.
- [Enable target](/api/v1/targets/{targetId}/enable): `POST`; JSON `{}`; reopens physical dispatch when other guards allow it.
- [Disable target](/api/v1/targets/{targetId}/disable): `POST`; JSON `{}`; blocks new dispatch without deleting history or forcibly terminating running RPC.
- [Retry execution](/api/v1/executions/{executionId}/retry): `POST`; JSON `{ "confirmRisk": true }`; same Execution and idempotency key, new Attempt.
- [Run execution again](/api/v1/executions/{executionId}/rerun): `POST`; JSON `{ "confirmRisk": true }`; creates a child Execution with a new idempotency key.
- [Cancel execution](/api/v1/executions/{executionId}/cancel): `POST`; JSON `{}`; only valid for waiting states, never force-kills running RPC.
- [Resolve unknown execution](/api/v1/executions/{executionId}/resolve): `POST`; JSON `{ "resolution": "confirmed_succeeded"|"confirmed_failed"|"abandon", "note": string, "confirmRisk": true }`.
- [Issue Registration Token](/api/v1/registration-tokens): `POST`; JSON `{ "targetId", "label", "expiresInDays"? }`; the raw token appears exactly once.
- [Rotate Registration Token](/api/v1/registration-tokens/{tokenId}/rotate): `POST`; JSON `{ "expiresInDays"? }`; atomically issues a replacement and revokes the old token.
- [Revoke Registration Token](/api/v1/registration-tokens/{tokenId}/revoke): `POST`; JSON `{}`; blocks future Registration without deleting the current declaration.
- [Pause all dispatch](/api/v1/system/pause): `POST`; JSON `{}`; persists the global dispatch safety switch.
- [Resume all dispatch](/api/v1/system/resume): `POST`; JSON `{}`; clears the global switch without overriding Target or Schedule guards.

## Canonical protocol documentation

- [Queue trigger integration](https://github.com/Liner03/cloudflare-unified-cron/blob/main/docs/queue-worker-integration.md): reliable delivery, website execution, per-delivery result reporting, free-tier boundaries and native Cron migration. `POST /api/v1/delivery-receipts/{deliveryId}` accepts strict JSON `{ "status": "succeeded"|"failed", "summary": string }` using a dedicated `ucrr_` Bearer capability for that delivery. It does not accept Admin Session or Registration Token as a substitute. Exact terminal replay is allowed; conflicting terminal results return 409. Never log the capability or whole Queue message.

- [RPC protocol](https://github.com/Liner03/cloudflare-unified-cron/blob/main/docs/protocol.md): Cron request/result envelopes, size limits, identity checks, Registration V1, revision semantics, and retry constraints.
- [Worker integration](https://github.com/Liner03/cloudflare-unified-cron/blob/main/docs/worker-integration.md): SDK usage, business idempotency, Registration publishing, Target allowlisting, and legacy Cron migration.
- [Cron semantics](https://github.com/Liner03/cloudflare-unified-cron/blob/main/docs/cron-semantics.md): accepted five-field subset, timezone behavior, DST cases, misfire policy, and next-run calculation.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/Liner03/cloudflare-unified-cron/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): D1 transactions, leases, materialization, claim/finalize boundaries, cleanup, and system limits.
- [Operations](https://github.com/Liner03/cloudflare-unified-cron/blob/main/docs/operations.md): fault interpretation, safe operator actions, retention, success-rate definitions, and logging correlation fields.
- [Deployment](https://github.com/Liner03/cloudflare-unified-cron/blob/main/docs/deployment.md): configuration, migrations, Secrets, deployment order, validation, and rollback boundaries.

## Optional

- [Operator console user stories](https://github.com/Liner03/cloudflare-unified-cron/blob/main/docs/operator-console-user-stories.md): intended human workflows and acceptance language.
- [Validation report](https://github.com/Liner03/cloudflare-unified-cron/blob/main/docs/validation-report.md): recorded local verification evidence and explicit remote-testing gaps.
- [Worker self-registration design](https://github.com/Liner03/cloudflare-unified-cron/blob/main/docs/self-registration.md): rationale and implementation decisions behind Worker-owned declarations.
